fields.label: Account Name
fields.description: The name this provider account is known by here, e.g. Acefone TatvaPractice.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The provider that places and receives this account's calls.
Ticked, this account places and receives calls. Unticked, it does nothing.
fields.label: Enabled

fields.description: The line the provider rings first on a click-to-call, before it dials the patient. Any format; only the last 10 digits are used.
fields.label: Agent Callback Number

fields.description: The number shown to the patient on an outgoing call. Any format; only the last 10 digits are used.
fields.label: Caller ID (outbound)
Provider Credentials (outbound — the CRM calls the provider)

fields.description: The provider's API address, with no trailing slash. Blank uses the built-in default, which for Acefone is https://api.acefone.in.
fields.label: Base URL

fields.description: The provider's API token for this account. Every outgoing call is authenticated with it.
fields.label: API Token

fields.description: Only for Acefone's separate Support click-to-call. Leave it blank for every other provider.
fields.label: Click-to-Call API Key
Webhook Token
fields.description: Generate one with the button above, save, then register the copied URLs with the provider. It proves the caller is the provider. Blank means nothing can be received.

fields.label: Recording Host Allowlist (SSRF)
fields.description: The provider's recording addresses. Listing them means a recording is only ever downloaded from those addresses. Blank allows any public address.

fields.label: Inbound Webhook (the provider calls the CRM)

fields.description: Set while a token is being replaced; both work until this is cleared. Acefone retries a rejected delivery only twice, so a call rejected mid-change is lost for good.
fields.label: Previous Webhook Token

fields.description: Filled in automatically. Never entered.
fields.label: Token Digest

fields.description: The token is always required. Add signature checking only for a provider that signs what it sends, which Acefone does not.
fields.label: Authentication
HMAC Signing Secret
fields.description: The shared secret the provider signs with.
The header carrying the signature, e.g. X-Signature.
fields.label: Signature Header
Signature Algorithm
fields.description: The hash the provider signs with.

fields.label: Signature Encoding
fields.description: The encoding the provider uses for the signature it sends.
Removed before the signature is compared, e.g. sha256=. Blank when the provider sends a bare signature.
fields.label: Signature Prefix

fields.description: Reject any inbound call not sent from an address listed below. Leave it off unless the provider publishes fixed addresses. It cannot be turned on while the list is empty.
fields.label: Enforce IP Allowlist

fields.description: One address or range per line, e.g. 13.234.10.5 or 13.234.0.0/16. Read only when the setting above is ticked.
fields.label: Allowed Addresses
